data.name: HoRoyal 〜Hololive Battle Royal〜
data.detailed_description:
An action game featuring over 60 Hololive talents is here!

◆Hololive talents' “GAYA (Live commentary) Voice” cheer you on!!

Featuring Hololive talents' voice clips sampled from their regular game streams, and many more!

Over 10,000 voices in total!!

Play the action game while enjoying the immersive feeling of a collaborative stream with these intense “GAYA (Live commentary) Voices”!

◆Go all out! Go wild! Run wild! Battle Royal!

You'll become a Hololive talent and adventure through this world!

In this world, forget about deep storylines or world-building—

just dive into the “Battle Royale” stage and fight using your “Abilities”!!

Engage in heated battles with pop skills and simple controls,

and with the addition of “GAYA (Live commentary) Voices”, the fights become even more intense!

Defeat enemies before they defeat you! Defeat them all! Run wild and rampage!!

◆Go on adventures with your favorite Hololive talents!

Battle effectiveness depend on “Abilities”, which can be freely equipped,

so there are no skill differences between Hololive talents!

Pick your favorite talent and adventure through this world!!

◆Interact with Hololive talents in the lobby!

Before entering the Battle Royale stage,

you can freely interact with Hololive talents (conversations, photo sessions) in the “Lobby”!

Plus, you may enjoy even more immersive interactions in “VR Mode”...?

data.short_description: A fan-made action game based on Hololive! Turn your brain off and enjoy some silly fun! Powerful voice clips cheer your exhilarating battles!! Experience the same sense of immersion as a collab livestream!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F ／ AMD Ryzen 7 2700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 ／ Radeon RX 6400
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR Compatible / Tested on Meta Quest 3S
